title: B-tree page count and last-page observation

scope.rationale: btreePagecount returns the current shared database page count and sqlite3BtreeLastPage exposes that count through a Btree handle under the caller-held B-tree mutex.

external_source_responsibilities: Shared page-list/count maintenance and caller lock discipline
dependencies.caller_closure: Both direct observation bodies are assigned; pager synchronization remains externally owned.

inputs: Live Shared for page count; live Btree under held mutex for last page
outputs: Current database page count / highest page number
contracts.ownership: Inputs are borrowed; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: The simplified owner uses the dense pages list length as the source nPage value.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: lastPage requires caller-held B-tree mutex; pageCount observes already-owned shared state. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Total for valid synchronized B-tree state.

representation_differences: The Zig Shared model's dense pages list length represents source BtShared.nPage; the source wrapper's mutex assertion is a caller contract.

oracle.protocol: Observe a newly initialized Shared with no loaded database pages through both direct and Btree-wrapper owners and compare zero.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; mutex and pager/count synchronization remain external.
assurance.malformed_input: Invalid shared ownership is outside the source contract.

integration.native_call_path: Typed observations and empty-state trace exist; live pager synchronization consumers remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires pager/count integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Synchronize dense page owner with native pager page count.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:2350-2374 was reviewed completely for cache lookup/page count/last-page context

callers: B-tree allocation, vacuum, backup, and page-count consumers
Unit trace invokes both owners directly
callees: sqlite3BtreeLastPage calls btreePagecount; Zig lastPage calls pageCount
assertions_branches_cleanup: All three active blocks are assigned
upstream_tests: Upstream page-count, allocation, vacuum, backup, and corruption tests cover these observations
